events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, but Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul anniversary
angles.copy: The Beatles changed the game with 'Rubber Soul', released on this day in '65. Which track from the album is still a regular on your playlist?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years since his passing, John Lennon's music and message continue to inspire. His legacy lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Happy 92nd heavenly birthday to the one and only King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley. His music still shakes us up!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the guitar god, Jimmy Page! From Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are legendary.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday, marking decades as a rock and pop icon.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the legendary Suggs! A true British icon and frontman of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the incredible Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Everytime You Go Away', an 80s legend.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true queen of music, philanthropy, and everything fabulous.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Pop royalty and a songwriting genius.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul legend Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams, get into our feeds.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall Of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Inaugural
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first-ever induction ceremony. Who was in that legendary first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to the ever-charming Mark Owen! Still got that boyband sparkle.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary drummer and singer-songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his charming roles, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the king of the rom-com, Hugh Grant! Which of his films is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Justin Timberlake
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to JT! From *NSYNC to solo sensation, he's still bringing SexyBack.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for Only Fools and Horses, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sir David Jason
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, music legends Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. A tragic day that forever changed music.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his timeless hits, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley! You know the drill... we're never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley's 82nd
angles.copy: Happy 82nd heavenly birthday to the legendary Bob Marley. His message of peace, love, and unity resonates more than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the iconic Carole King! 'Tapestry' remains one of the greatest albums of all time.

events.title: Whitney Houston would have been 64
events.blurb: We remember the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and legacy live on through her timeless music.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their initial split, devastating fans across the UK.

angles.name: Take That split day
angles.copy: Remember where you were on this day in 1996? The day Take That broke millions of hearts by announcing their split. Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing that Red, Red Wine vibe.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed Sheeran
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From Suffolk to global stadiums, what's your favourite Ed track?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: We remember The Beatles' 'quiet Beatle', George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison's 84th
angles.copy: Happy 84th heavenly birthday to the 'quiet Beatle', George Harrison. His solo work, especially 'My Sweet Lord', remains iconic.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Roger Daltrey
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey! Long live rock.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British pop singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Nik Kershaw
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw! Wouldn't it be good to hear your favourite track of his right now?
